title: Longest Mountain in Array
summary: Determine the length of the longest subarray in an integer array that forms a mountain.
statement: Determine the length of the longest subarray in an integer array that forms a mountain. A mountain array must have at least three elements, with a peak where elements rise to the peak and then fall. Return 0 if no such mountain subarray exists.
constraints: A mountain has length at least three, strictly rises, then strictly falls.
Return the maximum contiguous mountain length or zero.
hints: A mountain is characterized by consecutive up-step and down-step counts.
Scan slopes, resetting on plateaus and when a new rise follows descent.
Increment up/down by comparison; when both positive update up+down+1.
The counters describe the unique maximal slope run ending at each index.
editorial: The counters describe the unique maximal slope run ending at each index.

tests.explanation: No strict rise and fall exists.
